name: Pausing a subscription
description: The moment someone wants to stop for a while. Making it easy without making it thoughtless.
designQuestion: Can pausing feel generous rather than defensive, and still leave people likely to come back?
context: Support handles roughly forty pause requests a week by hand. Every one of them is a conversation we could have had in the product.

explorations.title: Pick a return date
explorations.premise: A pause with a date attached is a plan. A pause without one is a slow cancellation.
